settings.question: How do I contact SmartSource?
settings.answer: Start a live chat or send us an email using the options at the bottom of this page. You can also visit any of our stores.

settings.question: How do I cancel an order?
settings.answer: Message us as soon as possible with your order number. If your order hasn't shipped yet, we'll cancel it and refund you in full.

settings.question: How do I get a repair?
settings.answer: If your device has a problem, it's covered by our 1-year warranty. Contact us with your order number and a short description, and we'll repair or replace it.

settings.question: How do I get a refund?
settings.answer: You have 30 days from delivery to return any device for free, for any reason. Contact us to start a return and we'll refund you once it arrives back.

settings.question: What does refurbished mean?
settings.answer: A refurbished device had a previous owner, then went through our technicians: tested, repaired where needed, wiped, cleaned and graded. It works like new.

settings.question: What do the grades mean?
settings.answer: Grades only describe how a device looks, from Premium (like new) to Fair (visible wear). Every grade works perfectly and gets the same warranty.

settings.question: Is my data safe on a refurbished device?
settings.answer: Yes. Every device is fully wiped and restored to factory settings before it's sold.

settings.question: Where is my order?
settings.answer: Sign in to your account and open Orders to see status and tracking. You'll also get a shipping email with a tracking link.

settings.question: Can I change my order?
settings.answer: If it hasn't shipped, yes. Contact us with your order number and what you'd like to change.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Standard delivery takes 2 to 4 business days. Express delivery is available at checkout.

settings.question: Is shipping free?
settings.answer: Standard shipping is free on device orders.

settings.question: Can I pick up in store?
settings.answer: Yes, choose in-store pickup at checkout if it's offered for your location.

settings.question: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: All major credit and debit cards, plus the express payment options shown at checkout.

settings.question: Is checkout secure?
settings.answer: Yes. Payments are processed securely by Shopify. We never see or store your full card details.

settings.question: What's your return policy?
settings.answer: Free 30-day returns on every device, for any reason.

settings.question: How long do refunds take?
settings.answer: Once we receive and check your return, we refund to your original payment method. Your bank may take a few business days to show it.

settings.question: What does the warranty cover?
settings.answer: Our 1-year warranty covers any defect or failure that isn't caused by accidental damage, liquid damage or misuse.

settings.question: Can you fix accidental damage?
settings.answer: Yes, our technicians repair cracked screens, batteries and more. Accidental damage isn't covered by the warranty, but we'll quote you before any work.

settings.question: How does trade-in work?
settings.answer: Get an instant quote on our trade-in page, send your device with the free shipping label or drop it off in store, and get paid once we check it.

settings.question: Do I need to remove my accounts?
settings.answer: Yes. Sign out of iCloud or your Google account, turn off Find My, and remove your SIM card before you send it.

settings.question: Can I get a phone plan with my device?
settings.answer: Yes. Visit one of our stores and we'll set up your new phone with a mobile plan before you leave.

settings.question: Are your phones unlocked?
settings.answer: Yes. Our phones are carrier unlocked, so they work with any Canadian carrier.

settings.question: Do I need an account to order?
settings.answer: No, you can check out as a guest. An account makes it easier to track orders and returns.

settings.question: I forgot my password
settings.answer: On the sign-in page, choose Forgot your password and we'll email you a reset link.
